### Added

- (agent-platform) [Cut long user messages on the session page behind Show more](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3073) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — On a session's page, a long message you sent, such as the conversation carried into a continued session or a pasted log, shows its first 10 lines with `Show more` instead of filling the page.
- (agent-platform, muster, analytics-react) [Report tool runs and agent, model and connector lifecycle as usage data](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3076) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — For operators: the usage data now counts tool runs, deleting agents, creating, editing and deleting models, editing, turning on or off and removing connectors, and sending, answering, stopping, renaming and deleting in sessions. No names, identifiers or typed text are sent.
- (app, analytics-react) [Show the upstream notifications in the Notification inbox](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3074) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — The Agent Platform's notification bell also lists the notifications other portal features send you, next to your sessions, and marks them read when you open them or choose `Mark all read`.
- (app, muster) [Move the MCP sign-in card into the Notification inbox](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3075) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — MCP servers that need your sign-in show as one row in the Agent Platform's notification bell, e.g. `2 MCP servers need your sign-in`, with a sign-in button, instead of a card in the corner of every page.

### Fixed

- (app) [Send the route template instead of the path in page views](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3081) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — For operators: page views in the usage data carry the route template, e.g. `/sessions/:installation/:sessionId`, so no installation, agent, cluster or catalog entity names from page addresses are sent any more.
- (muster) [Keep the MCP sign-in notice's poll silent and reserve its room under page content](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3058) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — After the portal sign-in expired, the MCP sign-in notice no longer opens the `Login Required` dialog by itself. On a phone, pages make room for the notice, so their last content can be reached without `Not now`.
- (muster) [Word workflow effect badges like the tool badges](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3077) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — Workflows say what they do in the same words as tools, `Reads` or `Changes things`, and a workflow's badge explains in a tooltip what that means for its steps.

### Development and CI/CD

- (deps) [Update dependency @roadiehq/backstage-plugin-github-pull-requests to v3.9.0](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2978) by [@renovate[bot]](https://github.com/renovate[bot])
